```{r, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(cavalier)
stopifnot(
  exists('variant'),
  is.data.frame(variant)
)
```

```{r, results='asis'}

ft <-
  variant %>%
  select(symbol = SYMBOL) %>%
  left_join(
    cavalier:::get_gene_disease_map(source = 'OMIM') %>% 
      mutate(symbol = coalesce(hgnc_entrez2sym(entrez_id), 
                               hgnc_sym2sym(symbol))),
    by = 'symbol') %>% 
  mutate(disease_name = cavalier:::get_disease_names(disease_id)) %>% 
  mutate(disease_name_url = str_c('https://omim.org/entry/', str_extract(disease_id, '\\d+$')),
         disease_id_url = disease_name_url) %>% 
  select(disease_id, disease_name, inheritance, disease_id_url, disease_name_url) %>%
  cavalier:::flex_table()

html <- htmltools::renderTags(flextable::htmltools_value(ft))$html
# emit *just* the table HTML
cat(html)
```

```{r results='asis', echo=FALSE}
# `v` is the same one-row tibble
p   <- cavalier::plot_gtex_expression(
  gene = variant$SYMBOL,
  ensembl_id = variant$Gene)

tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
ggplot2::ggsave(tmp, p,
                width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 200, device = "png")
uri <- knitr::image_uri(tmp)

# emit *just* the <img> tag
cat(sprintf('<img src="%s" style="max-width:800px; height:auto;"/>', uri))
```
